verdict.rationale: Lithic documents a public developer API with endpoint references such as card creation, dated API versioning through the `api-version` header, and an Events API for managing webhooks. A probe of llms.txt confirms the API documentation is publicly reachable. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
